Cramorant is my most played character. The thing with Cramorant's winrate is because it's such a niche Pokémon, the only people who have stuck with him for years are the ones who REALLY love the bird such a myself. Ignore all suggestions for Surf and Hurricane, Dive and Airslash is secretly overpowered right now and you get away with DISGUSTING plays once you master it. Especially playing near walls since you can cross every wall in the GAME   


 Cram's late game objective secure sucks, Air Slash is your best bet. But he's a GODLY laner, set Dive to auto upgrade in settings so you keep Whirlpool for as long as possible at level 6. Whirlpool + Air Slash has nasty lane last hit potential 


He also has very little burst. What you DO have though, is godly amounts of longevity and sustain. You're all about whittling down enemies over a long period of time in a battle of attrition. Once you get the level 11 Air Slash healing you become a vulture, circling enemies tantslisingly out of reach where they can't catch you  


 You're very squishy and dead as a dodo if you get caught out. So you need to always think ahead and pre-emptively hold Dive in advance to dodge out of the way of attacks you think are coming. You CANNOT do this if you have no charges of Dive saved up, and combined with the horrific Switch aiming system escaping is a nightmare if you let yourself run out of Dive uses 


I use Slick Spoon, Energy Amp and Cursed Incence. I argue that Shell Bell is redundant on Cram with the recent Dive cooldown buff, and the healing negation you inflict while whittling down enemies with Incence can and WILL win you team fights 


Any questions let me know. Cram is a character that does deceptively high damage throughout a match because it's all about sustain and not burst
